第一七章 聚灵六品
让聂空有点意外，香香居然没有把自己体内的药力全部吸收掉，还剩下一半，估计只能撑过明天。
小家伙吃饱喝足，精力充足，小叶片起劲晃着，传递出继续练习“花爆”的强烈欲望。聂空没理它，而是继续揉捻金针，消融堵塞经脉的灵力。
奇经八脉中的任脉、督脉和冲脉这三条已经畅通，这次，聂空的目标是阴维脉和阳维脉两条。
其实，以聂空的九转金针，完全可以一天之内将所有的经脉全部疏通。只是他现在的身体是靠“健肌壮骨汤”改造出来的，暂时比不上常年修炼而自然淬炼出来的躯体，贸然疏通全部经脉，那突然融化开来的磅礴灵力恐怕会撑爆经脉、粉碎灵神三窍，让他彻底变成一个废人。
每天循序渐进，则要稳妥得多，聂空有足够的时间将溶解的灵力消化，经脉和灵神三窍也能逐渐适应灵力的暴增。
屋檐下，花眉坐在一块大木墩前。
木墩上面则是一根半米来长、初具雏形的木雕，花眉右腕颤动，小刻刀如同有了生命的活物一般，在她指间飞舞，锋锐的刀尖在木雕上面迅速游移，木屑如细密的雨点，纷纷洒落下来。
如此娴熟的动作，即便是高级灵师看了也会赞叹不已。
花眉没有修炼灵力的资质，可她的雕刻技术极其精湛，只是日日担心聂空病情，难以静下心来做这件事情。如今，聂空病情大好，花眉无需忧虑，再加上丢了洗衣的差事，正好做起雕刻来。
“嘚嘚嘚嘚……”
刻刀与木块接触时发出的清脆声响，连绵不绝，犹如一曲绝妙的旋律，在小小的庭院里回荡。
花眉红唇微抿，黑溜溜的两只美眸几乎是眨也不眨地凝视着身前的木块，眼神中充满专注与认真，那如玉娇靥在夕阳的映照下，透散出淡淡的莹光，晶莹润泽，柔嫩欲滴，说不住的赏心悦目。
恍惚间，花眉发现已经好久没听到叔叔练习灵术时的声音了，忍不住抬眼朝前面看了过去。
这一看，花眉那本就带着点晕霞的双颊变得更加嫣红，叔叔怎么在院子里就脱掉衣服扎起针来？
“哎哟。”
一声痛呼，花眉回过神来，忍不住黛眉微蹙，却是左手食指被刻刀划出了一道口子，鲜血汩汩而出。
“嫂嫂，怎么了？”
不远处的聂空弹身而起，双手从身前背后快速划过，九枚金针已落入掌中，也不等花眉回答，聂空便三两步跳了过来，抓起她的小手一看，柔声道：“原来是伤到手了，没关系，我来处理。”
“我、我……”

聂空**的上身近在眼前，隐隐间，似乎有股浓烈的男性气息钻入鼻端，花眉面红耳赤，紧张得有点说不出话来，左手下意识地往回一抽，却没能脱离聂空的掌握，心儿更是怦怦狂跳。
天可怜见，花眉虽然嫁了人，可实际上跟没出阁的女孩儿没什么区别，几乎从未这样被男人碰触过，何况，这男人还是她的叔叔。
聂空冲她微微一笑，右掌一晃，多余的金针收入宠物背包，只留下那枚细长的人针。“嗡”的一声悦耳的鸣响，翠绿灵力从金针上一闪而过，下一刻，金针便已刺在了花眉左手食指根部。
花眉正羞得有些无地自容，一看这情景，小嘴顿时微微张开。她多次见过聂空给他自己扎针，也幻象过那金针刺入身体时的感觉，现在亲身感受了一番，她才发现之前所想全部都是错误的。
那部位只是稍稍麻了一下，竟没有半点痛感。随着聂空不断揉捻金针，花眉只觉左手食指好似泡在温泉中一般，暖意融融的，不但伤口停止出血，手指的疼痛也在不断减轻，异常舒适。
“好了，过几天就会愈合。”
两三分钟后，聂空取出金针，满意地笑道。能够动用木系灵力后，聂空感觉自己的针灸术越发炉火纯青，花眉受的只是小伤，可伤口却有寸多长，要换在前世，这么扎一针就马上止血，简直不可想象。
“嗯。”
花眉下意识地应了声，忽地想起自己一出声聂空就跑了过来，有点担心的道，“叔叔，我没打搅你修炼吧？”
聂空不禁笑道：“没有，就算你不出声，我也要暂停修炼，刚才我已经突破到聚灵六品了。”
“这么快？”
花眉又惊又喜，还想说些什么，可目光留意到聂空暴露的胸膛时，好不容易才消散的红晕又爬满俏脸，嗖的一下把左手从聂空掌中抽出，“我……叔叔，天色不早，我……先去做饭了。”
“嫂嫂，那根手指别沾水。”
还是这么害羞。聂空摇头失笑，眼睛转向那木雕。蹲下去看看，聂空顿感惊奇，那上面雕刻的是一个老头，看眉目，好像是大成帝国数百年前的一名天灵强者，聂空前身曾看过他的画像，印象深刻。这木雕虽然还没有完全成形，可聂空却已从上面感受到了一股睥睨天下的傲意。
原本看到花眉拿着刻刀在雕刻，聂空并没怎么在意，现在才知道自己真的是看走眼了。雕刻和修炼一样，都讲究个资质，如果没有那天分，就算是天灵九品的超级强者也雕不出好东西来。
没想到花眉还有这绝活！
时间流逝，黑色笼罩了整个蓟阳城。卧房内，烛光摇曳，不时“哔剥”一下爆出小小的火花。
聂空端坐床上，忍不住嘟囔道：“香香，我看你药力充沛、精神旺盛，施展‘药鼎幻身’根本没有什么难度，干嘛非得休息整整十二个小时，你肯定是故意偷懒不想干活，我没说错吧？”
“啊呀呀，啊呀呀……”
小家伙在瑶池穴“手舞足蹈”，不停地分辨自己没有偷懒。

聂空暗暗偷笑。实际上，他早就知道了，只是等得无聊，想逗逗它。不休息够十二小时，会有碍紫罗幻灵香的发育生长，随着它的不断升级，施展“药鼎幻身”的间隔时间会渐渐缩短，或许香香到九阶后，随时都能召唤出药鼎。
“香香，还剩下几分钟？”
“一分钟。”
“好！”
聂空深吸口气，将香丝琉璃根等药包一一

Chapter 17 The Sixth Level of Gathering Spirits
To Nie Kong's surprise, Xiangxiang didn't absorb all the medicine in her body. Half of it was left, and she might only be able to survive tomorrow.
The little guy is full of food and drink, full of energy, and the small leaves are shaking vigorously, conveying a strong desire to continue practicing "flower explosion". Nie Kong ignored it and continued to twist the golden needles to dissolve the spiritual energy blocking the meridians.
Three of the eight extraordinary meridians, Ren, Du and Chong, have been unblocked. This time, Nie Kong's target is the Yin and Yang channels.
In fact, with Nie Kong's nine-turn golden needle, it is possible to clear all the meridians in one day. It's just that his current body was transformed by "muscle and bone strengthening soup", and it is temporarily inferior to the body that has been naturally tempered by years of practice. If all the meridians are rashly dredged, the majestic spiritual power that suddenly melts will probably explode the meridians, shatter the three spiritual orifices, and completely turn him into a useless person.
It is much safer to do it step by step every day. Nie Kong has enough time to digest the dissolved spiritual power, and his meridians and spiritual orifices can gradually adapt to the sudden increase in spiritual power.
Under the eaves, Huamei sat in front of a large wooden pier.
On top of the wooden pier was a roughly half-meter-long wooden sculpture that was beginning to take shape. Huamei's right wrist trembled, and the small carving knife flew between her fingers like a living thing. The sharp tip of the knife moved quickly on the wooden sculpture, and sawdust fell down like fine raindrops.
Even a senior spiritual master would be amazed by such skillful movements.
Huamei does not have the qualifications to cultivate spiritual power, but her carving skills are extremely superb. However, she is worried about Nie Kong's condition every day and has difficulty calming down to do this work. Now that Nie Kong is in good condition, Huamei doesn't need to worry. In addition, he has lost his laundry errand, so he can start carving.
"嘘嘚嘚嘚..."
The crisp sound made when the carving knife comes into contact with the wood block is continuous, like a wonderful melody, echoing in the small courtyard.
Her beautiful eyebrows and red lips were slightly pursed, and her two beautiful black eyes were staring at the wooden block in front of her almost without blinking. Her eyes were full of concentration and seriousness. Under the reflection of the setting sun, the jade-like dimples exuded a faint glimmer of light, crystal moist and tender, which was indescribably pleasing to the eye.
In a daze, Huamei realized that it had been a long time since she heard her uncle's voice practicing spiritual arts, and couldn't help but raise her eyes and look ahead.
At this look, Huamei's cheeks, which were already a little rosy, became even more rosy. Why did uncle take off his clothes and get needles in the yard?
"Ouch."
With a cry of pain, Huamei came back to her senses. She couldn't help but frown slightly, but a cut was made on the index finger of her left hand with a carving knife, and blood gurgled out.
"Sister-in-law, what's wrong?"
Not far away, Nie Kong jumped up and quickly moved his hands across the front and back. Nine golden needles fell into his palms. Without waiting for Huamei's reply, Nie Kong jumped over and grabbed her little hand. He looked at it and said softly: "It turns out that the hand was injured. It doesn't matter. I'll take care of it."
"I, I..."
Nie Kong's naked upper body was in front of his eyes, and there seemed to be a strong masculine scent entering his nose. His eyebrows were red, and he was so nervous that he could not speak. His left hand subconsciously twitched back, but it failed to break away from Nie Kong's grasp. His heart was beating wildly.
Unfortunately, although Huamei is married, she is actually no different from a girl who has not left the court. She has almost never been touched by a man like this. What's more, this man is still her uncle.
Nie Kong smiled at her, flicked his right palm, and put the extra gold needles into his pet backpack, leaving only the slender human needle. There was a sweet sound of "buzz", and the emerald green spiritual power flashed from the golden needle. The next moment, the golden needle had pierced the root of the index finger of Huamei's left hand.
Huamei was so embarrassed that she felt ashamed. When she saw this scene, her little mouth suddenly opened slightly. She had seen Nie Kong pricking himself with acupuncture many times, and had also imagined the feeling of the golden needle piercing his body. Now she felt it for herselfAfter some searching, she realized that everything she had thought before was wrong.
The area was only slightly numb, but there was no pain at all. As Nie Kong continued to twist the golden needle, Huamei felt that her left index finger felt like it was soaked in a hot spring, warm and cozy. Not only did the wound stop bleeding, but the pain in the finger also continued to reduce, making it extremely comfortable.
"Okay, it will heal in a few days."
Two or three minutes later, Nie Kong took out the golden needle and smiled with satisfaction. After being able to use the wood spiritual power, Nie Kong felt that his acupuncture skills were becoming more and more proficient. Huamei suffered only a small injury, but the wound was more than an inch long. In his previous life, it would have been unimaginable to stop the bleeding immediately with just one injection.
"Yeah."
Huamei subconsciously responded, but suddenly remembered that Nie Kong ran over as soon as she said something, and said a little worriedly, "Uncle, I didn't disturb your practice, did I?"
Nie Kong couldn't help but smile and said: "No, even if you don't say anything, I will stop practicing. I have already broken through to the sixth level of gathering spirit just now."
"So fast?"
Huamei was surprised and happy, and wanted to say something, but when her eyes noticed Nie Kong's exposed chest, the blush that had finally dissipated spread all over her pretty face again. With a swish, she took her left hand out of Nie Kong's palm, "My... uncle, it's getting late, I... will go cook first."
"Sister-in-law, don't get that finger wet."
Still so shy. Nie Kong shook his head and laughed, turning his eyes to the wooden sculpture. Nie Kong knelt down and took a look. He was surprised. The carving on it was an old man. Judging from his facial features, he seemed to be a strong man from the Dacheng Empire hundreds of years ago. Nie Kong had seen his portrait before and was deeply impressed. Although this wooden sculpture has not yet been fully formed, Nie Kong can already feel a sense of arrogance from above.
Originally seeing Huamei carving with a carving knife, Nie Kong didn't pay much attention to it, but now he realized that he had really made a mistake. Sculpting, like cultivation, requires aptitude. If you don't have that talent, even a super expert of the ninth level of Tianling will not be able to carve good things.
I didn’t expect Huamei to have such a unique skill!
As time passed, black enveloped the entire Jiyang City. In the bedroom, the candlelight flickered, and small sparks popped out from time to time.
Nie Kong sat on the bed and couldn't help but muttered: "Xiangxiang, I see that you are full of medicinal power and energetic. It is not difficult to perform the 'Medicine Cauldron Illusion Body' at all. Why do you have to rest for a full twelve hours? You must be deliberately lazy and don't want to work. Am I right?"
"Ah ah ah ah ah ah..."
The little guy was "dancing" at the Yaochi point, constantly trying to tell that he was not lazy.
Nie Kong snickered secretly. In fact, he already knew it, but he was bored with waiting and wanted to tease it. Not resting for twelve hours will hinder the development and growth of Ziluo Magic Spirit Incense. As it continues to upgrade, the interval between performing the "Medicine Cauldron Illusion Body" will gradually shorten. Perhaps after Xiangxiang reaches the ninth level, it can summon the medicinal cauldron at any time.
"Xiangxiang, how many minutes are left?"
"One minute."
"Okay!"
Nie Kong took a deep breath and packed the fragrant silk and glazed roots and other medicine packages one by one.
